title: A mailbox send to a local session's listed display name resolves to its domain principal and is saved without waking the recipient
outcome: Sending routine mail to a local root session by its listed display name either wakes that local session through its native mailbox, or is refused with a remedy naming the native session id; it is never silently saved unwoken in a separate domain mailbox.
acceptance: A routine send whose target is a listed display name of a LOCAL root session (for example 'Termal::Sol-03d4') is delivered to that session's native mailbox and wakes it, or is refused before saving with a remedy naming the exact native id (session-N or host:UUID::session-N); it does not create or use a separate domain-principal mailbox that the recipient is never woken for.

A behavioural test covers name-to-local-session delivery and wake, plus the remote-host case, and existing exact-id and domain-id sends keep their behaviour; the change has a clean review pair and passes the full gate.
